name: gluefrayjs
description: Public workspace for the Glue reactive core and Fray UI runtime.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/glue typecheck && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/fray typecheck && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/fray-visualization typecheck && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/fray-demo typecheck && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/dummy-server typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/glue test && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/fray test && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/fray-visualization test && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/dummy-server test
scripts.test:types: pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/glue test:types:consumer && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/fray test:types:consumer && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/fray-visualization test:types:consumer
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/glue build && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/fray build && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/fray-visualization build && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/fray-demo build
scripts.verify: pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm test:tooling && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:types
scripts.verify:release: pnpm verify && pnpm test:browser && pnpm pack:check && pnpm scan:public && node scripts/public-release-preflight.mjs
